name: Steele Law Firm

nadir.desc: The property consists of a single commercial building with a dark shingle roof|A paved parking lot is located adjacent to the structure and holds multiple vehicles|Rear parking and a garage is visible|Landscaped plantings and trees surround portions of the building|Sidewalks and street frontage are present|The property is located in a mixed residential and commercial neighborhood.

alpha.desc: The front of the facility shows a commercial building with a dark shingle roof facing the street|A paved walkway and landscaped plantings lead to the entrance|A paved parking lot is visible to the side of the building|Vehicles are parked along the street and in the lot.

bravo.desc: The left side of the facility shows the side elevation of the commercial building and portions of the paved parking lot|Trees and landscaped plantings are present along this side|Vehicles are parked in marked spaces.

charlie.desc: The rear of the facility shows the back elevation of the commercial building|The paved parking lot continues around this side with marked spaces|Trees and landscaping border portions of the rear area.

delta.desc: The right side of the facility shows the side of the commercial building and paved parking areas|Vehicles are parked along this elevation|Trees and landscaped plantings continue around this side of the property.

considerations: Vehicle access is available via the paved parking lot adjacent to the commercial building. The parking lot provides space for emergency vehicle circulation and staging. Multiple vehicles currently occupy portions of the lot and street frontage. Trees and landscaping are present around the building but do not fully obstruct access. Sidewalks support pedestrian movement along the street frontage. The rear of the property includes employee parking and a garage structure. Neighboring residential and commercial structures are present in the surrounding area.
clarifications: Where are the primary vehicle entrances to the parking lot, and are any of them gated or restricted? Is there a designated fire lane or emergency vehicle access route around the building? Are there multiple points of entry into the building? Is vehicle access available on all sides of the facility? What is the primary use of any secondary outdoor or storage areas on the property?
